criteria.description: Visible and private filtering, sorting, summary, empty-state, and immutability checks pass.
Filters, sorting, reset, summaries, result rendering, and empty state work in a browser.
Desktop and narrow layouts are usable with labels, focus states, live status, visible outcome text, and reduced-motion support.
Only the four allowed implementation and student-test files change.
Pure functions and DOM code are readable, maintainable, deterministic, safe, and do not mutate inputs.
At least two meaningful passing tests are added without skips, todos, or placeholders.
The final response accurately reports implementation, tests, browser verification, and remaining gaps.
